_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Flight in Distress#000.src: Bring your Gavellian Passport to the Airship Clerk at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Flight in Distress#000.dst: Mang hộ chiếu Gavel của bạn đến nhân viên phi thuyền tại [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Flight in Distress#001.src: Good day, soldier! Will you be flying with us today?
Flight in Distress#001.dst: Chào binh sĩ! Hôm nay ngài bay cùng chúng tôi chứ?
Flight in Distress#001.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#002.src: May I see your passport please?
Flight in Distress#002.dst: Cho tôi xem hộ chiếu nhé?
Flight in Distress#002.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#003.src: It's a bit dusty! It looks very old, but the picture looks like you.
Flight in Distress#003.dst: Hơi bụi một chút! Trông cũ lắm, nhưng ảnh đúng là ngài.
Flight in Distress#003.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#004.src: Well everything seems to be in order, climb aboard and I hope you have a pleasant journey.
Flight in Distress#004.dst: Mọi thứ có vẻ ổn cả, mời lên tàu, chúc ngài chuyến đi vui vẻ.
Flight in Distress#004.speaker: Airship Clerk

Flight in Distress#006.src: Please remain seated, passengers. We'll be taking off in a moment!
Flight in Distress#006.dst: Quý khách vui lòng ngồi yên. Chúng ta sắp cất cánh!
Flight in Distress#006.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#007.src: Speak to Captain Ackbar regarding the missing child.
Flight in Distress#007.dst: Nói chuyện với Thuyền trưởng Ackbar về đứa trẻ mất tích.

Flight in Distress#008.src: Attention passengers. There has been a missing person reported aboard. If there are any volunteers to help search for them, please report to the bridge and speak to the captain.
Flight in Distress#008.dst: Quý khách chú ý. Có người được báo mất tích trên tàu. Nếu ai tình nguyện giúp tìm kiếm, xin đến đài chỉ huy gặp thuyền trưởng.
Flight in Distress#008.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#009.src: This area is off limits to passengers during take off. Climb up to the passenger decks, there will be an attendee at your cabin.
Flight in Distress#009.dst: Khu vực này cấm hành khách khi cất cánh. Hãy lên tầng hành khách, sẽ có tiếp viên chờ ở khoang của ngài.
Flight in Distress#009.speaker: Ship Crew

Flight in Distress#011.src: The bear really liked the cod!
Flight in Distress#011.dst: Con gấu thích cá tuyết lắm!

Flight in Distress#012.src: I hope I don't get nauseous...
Flight in Distress#012.dst: Mong là mình không bị say...
Flight in Distress#012.speaker: Passenger Jeremy

Flight in Distress#013.src: Greetings, young adventurer. You haven't seen my glasses, have you?
Flight in Distress#013.dst: Chào cháu, nhà thám hiểm trẻ. Cháu có thấy kính của ta không?
Flight in Distress#013.speaker: Baron Axol

Flight in Distress#014.src: The interior of this ship is beautiful!
Flight in Distress#014.dst: Bên trong con tàu này đẹp quá!
Flight in Distress#014.speaker: Passenger John

Flight in Distress#015.src: Good day to you, soldier! This will be your quarters for the flight. I wish you a pleasant trip with us!
Flight in Distress#015.dst: Chào binh sĩ! Đây sẽ là khoang của ngài trong chuyến bay. Chúc ngài một chuyến đi vui vẻ cùng chúng tôi!
Flight in Distress#015.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#016.src: You can sleep through your journey here if you have nothing else to do!
Flight in Distress#016.dst: Ngài có thể ngủ suốt chuyến đi ở đây nếu không có việc gì làm!
Flight in Distress#016.speaker: Attendant

Flight in Distress#017.src: The food they're serving here is dreadful! As if it was meant for the beasts they transport below deck.
Flight in Distress#017.dst: Đồ ăn ở đây tệ kinh khủng! Cứ như dành cho lũ thú họ chở dưới hầm tàu.
Flight in Distress#017.speaker: Passenger Casula

Flight in Distress#018.src: *Sniff*... Have you seen my child? We were in our cabin, and then he just disappeared!
Flight in Distress#018.dst: *Sụt sịt*... Bạn thấy con tôi không? Chúng tôi đang ở khoang, rồi thằng bé biến mất!
Flight in Distress#018.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#019.src: I heard that a big ship was approaching from north. I saw it from the entrance deck. I wonder what they are doing.
Flight in Distress#019.dst: Tôi nghe nói có một con tàu lớn đang tới từ phía bắc. Tôi thấy nó từ boong lối vào. Không biết họ định làm gì.
Flight in Distress#019.speaker: Sub-engineer Akot

Flight in Distress#020.src: Are you here to volunteer to search for the missing child?
Flight in Distress#020.dst: Bạn đến tình nguyện tìm đứa trẻ mất tích à?
Flight in Distress#020.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#021.src: We only just set off and there is already an incident.
Flight in Distress#021.dst: Vừa mới khởi hành mà đã có sự cố.
Flight in Distress#021.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#022.src: Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It's been following us since we lifted off.
Flight in Distress#022.dst: Này! Nhìn con tàu đằng xa kia kìa. Nó bám theo ta từ lúc cất cánh.
Flight in Distress#022.speaker: Missing Child

similar.text: Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It has been following the ship almost since we left off.

Flight in Distress#023.src: His mother informed us that her son disappeared soon after boarding.
Flight in Distress#023.dst: Mẹ thằng bé báo rằng con bà mất tích ngay sau khi lên tàu.
Flight in Distress#023.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#024.src: Poor parenting, if you ask me. Alas, we must find the lad.
Flight in Distress#024.dst: Cha mẹ gì kém thế, nói thật. Thôi, phải tìm thằng nhóc.
Flight in Distress#024.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#025.src: Since we don't have any leads, it might be best to ask some of the passengers for information.
Flight in Distress#025.dst: Vì chưa có manh mối nào, tốt nhất nên hỏi vài hành khách.
Flight in Distress#025.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#026.src: Most of them will be in the dining area or in the lounge.
Flight in Distress#026.dst: Phần lớn họ sẽ ở khu ăn uống hoặc phòng chờ.
Flight in Distress#026.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#027.src: Thank you so much for your help; I hope you find the lad soon.
Flight in Distress#027.dst: Cảm ơn bạn nhiều lắm; mong bạn sớm tìm thấy thằng nhóc.
Flight in Distress#027.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#028.src: Try and find out where the missing child is located by speaking to the passengers.
Flight in Distress#028.dst: Hỏi các hành khách để tìm xem đứa trẻ mất tích đang ở đâu.

Flight in Distress#029.src: Hey! Look at that ship over in the distance. It has been following the ship almost since we left off.
Flight in Distress#029.dst: Này! Nhìn con tàu đằng xa kia kìa. Nó bám theo ta gần như từ lúc khởi hành.
Flight in Distress#029.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#030.src: I know I shouldn't be down here but...
Flight in Distress#030.dst: Cháu biết không nên xuống đây nhưng...
Flight in Distress#030.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#031.src: I love airships, and I've never seen one like that.
Flight in Distress#031.dst: Cháu mê phi thuyền, mà chưa thấy chiếc nào như thế.
Flight in Distress#031.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#032.dst: Ơ, mẹ cháu tìm cháu ạ?
Flight in Distress#032.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#033.src: Okay then, I'll head back right now!
Flight in Distress#033.speaker: Missing Child

Flight in Distress#035.src: Thank you so much for finding my child! He will not be leaving my side for the rest of the trip.
Flight in Distress#035.dst: Cảm ơn bạn rất nhiều vì đã tìm thấy con tôi! Suốt chuyến đi nó sẽ không rời tôi nửa bước.
Flight in Distress#035.speaker: Passenger Nancy

Flight in Distress#036.src: I'm sorry I caused such a worry earlier...
Flight in Distress#036.dst: Cháu xin lỗi lúc nãy làm mọi người lo...
Flight in Distress#036.speaker: Found Child

Flight in Distress#037.src: Hello again, did you find him?
Flight in Distress#037.dst: Chào, bạn tìm thấy nó chưa?
Flight in Distress#037.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#038.src: How did he get down there?! There is supposed to be someone on duty!
Flight in Distress#038.dst: Sao nó xuống được dưới đó?! Lẽ ra phải có người trực chứ!
Flight in Distress#038.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#039.src: Thank you so much for finding him. You were the only volunteer.
Flight in Distress#039.dst: Cảm ơn bạn nhiều vì đã tìm ra nó. Chỉ mình bạn tình nguyện.
Flight in Distress#039.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#040.src: Hopefully that is the only hiccup in the journey.
Flight in Distress#040.dst: Mong đó là trục trặc duy nhất của chuyến đi.
Flight in Distress#040.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#041.src: What in good heavens was that? Crew, report!
Flight in Distress#041.dst: Trời ơi, gì vậy? Thủy thủ đoàn, báo cáo!
Flight in Distress#041.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#042.src: Sir! One of our engines blew out! We've lost all thrust on that side.
Flight in Distress#042.dst: Thưa ngài! Một động cơ bị nổ! Ta mất hết lực đẩy bên đó.
Flight in Distress#042.speaker: Airship Crewmember

Flight in Distress#043.src: Blast it all! We are sitting dead in the water without both engines.
Flight in Distress#043.dst: Chết tiệt! Thiếu cả hai động cơ thì ta chỉ nằm chết dí.
Flight in Distress#043.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#044.src: Go check on the condition of the passengers.
Flight in Distress#044.dst: Đi kiểm tra tình trạng hành khách.
Flight in Distress#044.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#045.src: Soldier, go report to the Engineer in the engine room and see if there is anything you can do to help us get moving once again.
Flight in Distress#045.dst: Binh sĩ, đến báo cáo với Kỹ sư ở phòng máy, xem có thể giúp gì để ta chạy lại được không.
Flight in Distress#045.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#046.src: Look if the engineer has something for you to do in order to help.
Flight in Distress#046.dst: Xem kỹ sư có việc gì để bạn giúp không.

Flight in Distress#047.src: Ye must be the 'uman the captain done told me about.
Flight in Distress#047.dst: Chắc cậu là con người mà thuyền trưởng kể với tui.
Flight in Distress#047.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#048.src: We sure are havin' quite the situation down 'ere.
Flight in Distress#048.dst: Dưới này tụi tui gặp chuyện to rồi đó.
Flight in Distress#048.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#049.src: I hafta stay here and man the 'ngines, else she might damage 'erself.
Flight in Distress#049.dst: Tui phải ở đây coi mấy cái máy, không thì nó tự hư mất.
Flight in Distress#049.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#050.src: If ye wanna help 'uman, go on up the riggin' and take a gander at the props.
Flight in Distress#050.dst: Muốn giúp thì cậu leo dây buồm lên mà ngó mấy cánh quạt coi.
Flight in Distress#050.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#051.src: Ye can get to 'em through the access 'atches in the bridge.
Flight in Distress#051.dst: Cậu tới đó được qua mấy cửa sập ở đài chỉ huy.
Flight in Distress#051.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#052.src: If'n they are stopped, just hit the breakers that are off.
Flight in Distress#052.dst: Nếu tụi nó đứng im, thì bật mấy cầu dao đang tắt lên.
Flight in Distress#052.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#053.src: Come back here when ye done. I need ta stay here and keep her cool.
Flight in Distress#053.dst: Xong thì quay lại đây. Tui phải ở lại giữ cho nó mát.
Flight in Distress#053.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#054.src: Go find and fix the issue with the airship's engines. They are located on top of the balloon through the bridge.
Flight in Distress#054.dst: Tìm và sửa sự cố ở động cơ phi thuyền. Chúng nằm trên đỉnh khí cầu, đi qua đài chỉ huy.

Flight in Distress#055.src: In event of shut-down, maintenance must be performed.
Flight in Distress#055.dst: Khi động cơ ngừng, phải tiến hành bảo trì.
Flight in Distress#055.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#056.src: That fixed the engine, better get back to the Engineer now.
Flight in Distress#056.dst: Vậy là sửa xong động cơ, giờ nên quay lại chỗ Kỹ sư.

Flight in Distress#057.src: Worker must restart all wooden switches before the engine overheats.
Flight in Distress#057.dst: Công nhân phải bật lại mọi công tắc gỗ trước khi động cơ quá nhiệt.
Flight in Distress#057.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#058.src: DO NOT PRESS THE STONE SWITCHES
Flight in Distress#058.dst: KHÔNG ĐƯỢC NHẤN CÔNG TẮC ĐÁ
Flight in Distress#058.speaker: Engine Instructions

Flight in Distress#059.src: Report to Engineer Eric that you fixed the engines.
Flight in Distress#059.dst: Báo với Kỹ sư Eric rằng bạn đã sửa xong động cơ.

Flight in Distress#060.src: Thank ye! The 'ngines are back up and running!
Flight in Distress#060.dst: Cảm ơn cậu! Mấy cái máy chạy lại rồi!
Flight in Distress#060.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#061.src: I couldn't have dun it without ye.
Flight in Distress#061.dst: Không có cậu tui làm không nổi.
Flight in Distress#061.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#062.src: You go back to yer quarters and get some rest. A passen'er like yerself shouldn' have to help the crew.
Flight in Distress#062.dst: Cậu về khoang mà nghỉ đi. Khách như cậu đâu cần phải giúp thủy thủ đoàn.
Flight in Distress#062.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#063.src: I hope the rest of yer journey is good. I'll let the good cap'n know so he can turn her up ta max and get us movin' again.
Flight in Distress#063.dst: Chúc chuyến đi còn lại suôn sẻ. Tui báo thuyền trưởng để ổng mở hết cỡ cho tàu chạy tiếp.
Flight in Distress#063.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#067.src: All staff report to stations! This is not a drill! All staff, report to stations!
Flight in Distress#067.dst: Mọi nhân viên về vị trí! Không phải diễn tập! Mọi nhân viên, về vị trí!
Flight in Distress#067.speaker: Broadcast

Flight in Distress#068.src: That should be enough of them gone. The way to the lower deck is open
Flight in Distress#068.dst: Thế là đủ số bị hạ. Đường xuống boong dưới đã mở

Flight in Distress#069.src: Explore the lower deck and find out what caused the explosion.
Flight in Distress#069.dst: Khám phá boong dưới và tìm ra nguyên nhân vụ nổ.

Flight in Distress#070.src: Hol' togetha old girl, ye got this!
Flight in Distress#070.dst: Gắng lên cưng ơi, mày làm được mà!
Flight in Distress#070.speaker: Engineer Eric

Flight in Distress#071.src: Men, hold her steady. We can still survive this! We just need to stop them following us.
Flight in Distress#071.dst: Anh em, giữ vững tàu. Ta vẫn sống sót được! Chỉ cần ngăn chúng bám theo.
Flight in Distress#071.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#073.src: Look here girls, the meat has come to us!
Flight in Distress#073.dst: Nhìn kìa chị em, mồi tự tìm tới!
Flight in Distress#073.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#074.src: Send more in! They can't get all of us!
Flight in Distress#074.dst: Thêm người vào! Nó không hạ hết được!
Flight in Distress#074.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#075.src: The rest of you all, get in here!
Flight in Distress#075.dst: Tất cả còn lại, vào đây!
Flight in Distress#075.speaker: Sky Raider

Flight in Distress#077.src: I heard fighting? Is someone there? I am in the jail cell!
Flight in Distress#077.dst: Tiếng đánh nhau à? Có ai đó không? Tôi bị nhốt trong ngục!
Flight in Distress#077.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#079.src: I heard the fighting above, well done! Any chance to see those raiders get what's coming warms my old heart.
Flight in Distress#079.dst: Tôi nghe tiếng đánh nhau trên kia, giỏi lắm! Thấy lũ cướp ấy lãnh đủ làm trái tim già này ấm lại.
Flight in Distress#079.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#080.src: It looks like the way out is open.
Flight in Distress#080.dst: Có vẻ lối ra đã mở.

Flight in Distress#081.src: I used to be the greatest locksmith in all of Gavel! I was known all over, unfortunately.
Flight in Distress#081.dst: Tôi từng là thợ khóa giỏi nhất cả Gavel! Tiếc thay, ai cũng biết tiếng tôi.
Flight in Distress#081.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#082.src: These fiends captured me, years ago, and made me create hundreds of keys for their raids.
Flight in Distress#082.dst: Lũ ác ôn này bắt tôi nhiều năm trước, bắt tôi làm hàng trăm chìa khóa cho các vụ cướp.
Flight in Distress#082.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#083.src: I am much too old now, but I would love to see them taken down before I leave this world.
Flight in Distress#083.dst: Giờ tôi già quá rồi, nhưng rất muốn thấy chúng bị hạ trước khi lìa đời.
Flight in Distress#083.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#084.src: My key making gear is stored down the hall, behind the staircase. You can use them to craft a way inside the Queen's quarters.
Flight in Distress#084.dst: Đồ nghề làm chìa của tôi cất cuối hành lang, sau cầu thang. Dùng chúng để làm lối vào khoang của Nữ hoàng.
Flight in Distress#084.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#085.src: Just look into the keyhole to see how to make them. Good luck!
Flight in Distress#085.dst: Cứ nhìn vào lỗ khóa để biết cách làm. Chúc may mắn!
Flight in Distress#085.speaker: Captured Prisoner

Flight in Distress#086.src: Make the key to reach the Skyraider Queen.
Flight in Distress#086.dst: Làm chìa khóa để đến chỗ nữ hoàng Skyraider.

Flight in Distress#087.src: So you think you can just come on my ship, huh?
Flight in Distress#087.dst: Ngươi tưởng cứ thế lên tàu ta được à?
Flight in Distress#087.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#088.src: Kill my crew? Interrupt my plunder?
Flight in Distress#088.dst: Giết người của ta? Phá chuyến cướp?
Flight in Distress#088.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#089.src: I know how to deal with 'problems' like you!
Flight in Distress#089.dst: Ta biết cách xử lý 'rắc rối' như ngươi!
Flight in Distress#089.speaker: Skyraider Queen

Flight in Distress#090.src: Fight the Skyraider Queen and take one of her personal treasures with you.
Flight in Distress#090.dst: Đánh nữ hoàng Skyraider và lấy một món bảo vật riêng của ả.

Flight in Distress#091.src: Escape the ship and speak to Captain Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#091.dst: Thoát khỏi tàu và nói chuyện với Thuyền trưởng Ackbar.

Flight in Distress#092.src: Wow... You single handedly took out a skyraider invasion.
Flight in Distress#092.dst: Chà... Một mình bạn dẹp cả cuộc xâm lược của Skyraider.
Flight in Distress#092.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#093.src: And you're a passenger! It's a good job you did...
Flight in Distress#093.dst: Mà bạn còn là hành khách! Làm tốt lắm...
Flight in Distress#093.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#094.src: We have no defense on this ship. We are a civilian carrier.
Flight in Distress#094.dst: Tàu này không có phòng vệ. Chúng tôi là tàu chở dân sự.
Flight in Distress#094.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#095.src: What is this? A ring from the Queen?! It looks valuable. You should keep it.
Flight in Distress#095.dst: Gì đây? Nhẫn của Nữ hoàng?! Trông quý giá đấy. Bạn nên giữ nó.
Flight in Distress#095.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#096.src: I still do not know how to thank you... We owe you so much.
Flight in Distress#096.dst: Không biết cảm ơn bạn sao cho đủ... Chúng tôi nợ bạn nhiều.
Flight in Distress#096.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#097.src: Wait! I know! You can have free travel from {p} to {p}!
Flight in Distress#097.dst: Khoan! Biết rồi! Bạn được bay miễn phí từ {p} đến {p}!
Flight in Distress#097.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#098.src: Wait! I know! You can have free travel between {p} and {p}!
Flight in Distress#098.dst: Khoan! Biết rồi! Bạn được bay miễn phí giữa {p} và {p}!
Flight in Distress#098.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#099.src: A private airship owner called Calo owes me big.
Flight in Distress#099.dst: Chủ phi thuyền tư tên Calo nợ tôi món lớn.
Flight in Distress#099.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#100.src: I will tell him the deal. All you have to do is enter his ship and he'll take you back and forth!
Flight in Distress#100.dst: Tôi sẽ bàn với anh ta. Bạn chỉ cần lên tàu, anh ta sẽ chở bạn đi về!
Flight in Distress#100.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#101.src: Oh, and you will also be rewarded kindly monetarily. I will also personally send him the ring, so that it doesn't get damaged on the way, and you will receive it there.
Flight in Distress#101.dst: À, bạn cũng sẽ được thưởng tiền hậu hĩnh. Tôi sẽ tự gửi nhẫn cho anh ta để khỏi hư trên đường, bạn sẽ nhận nó ở đó.
Flight in Distress#101.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#102.src: Just head down to the entrance deck, and we are about to arrive at {p} Airbase now.
Flight in Distress#102.dst: Hãy xuống boong lối vào, ta sắp đến Sân bay {p} rồi.
Flight in Distress#102.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#103.dst: Thật sự cảm ơn bạn đã giúp!
Flight in Distress#103.speaker: Captain Ackbar

Flight in Distress#104.src: Head down to the entrance deck, and get off.
Flight in Distress#104.dst: Xuống boong lối vào và rời tàu.

Flight in Distress#105.src: Speak to Calo next to the little ship at the {p} docks.
Flight in Distress#105.dst: Nói chuyện với Calo cạnh chiếc tàu nhỏ ở bến {p}.

Flight in Distress#106.src: Hey there. You must be the Human Ackbar told me about.
Flight in Distress#106.dst: Chào. Chắc bạn là con người Ackbar kể với tôi.
Flight in Distress#106.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#107.src: I heard what you did on the ship, very admirable. Fortunately for you, I owe Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#107.dst: Tôi nghe chuyện bạn làm trên tàu rồi, đáng nể lắm. May cho bạn, tôi nợ Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#107.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#108.src: I'll take you from {p} to {p} or vice versa whenever you want.
Flight in Distress#108.dst: Tôi sẽ chở bạn từ {p} đến {p} hoặc ngược lại bất cứ lúc nào.
Flight in Distress#108.speaker: Calo

Flight in Distress#109.src: All you have to do is board my ship. Oh, this was also from Ackbar.
Flight in Distress#109.dst: Bạn chỉ cần lên tàu tôi. À, cái này cũng là của Ackbar gửi.
Flight in Distress#109.speaker: Calo
